about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: At WAI Soft we make a difference
about.storyText: At WAI Soft we make a difference. Professionals providing solutions based on technology, creativity, and innovation. We carry businesses from concept to market-ready brand. We are a company that lives on the cutting-edge of technology focusing on quality and service. We are a technical partner for enterprises and startups looking for a responsible firm to guide them through the business development process. Our team consists of professionals committed to excellence and skilled in crafting innovative solutions.
about.meaningText: W + AI = WAY - Your way to the digital future
about.missionText: Empowering businesses with digital transformation using the latest technologies
about.visionText: To be the leading technology partner in the region
about.valuesCustomerDrivenDesc: We prioritize client principles over profit, delivering value that customers expect.
about.valuesInnovationDesc: We strongly believe in innovation – helping to create a better tomorrow.
about.valuesTechnologyDesc: Focused on your long-term success, we explore and implement the latest in technological solutions.
about.approachText: In an effort to assist our team of professionals reach its full potential our business follows a non-hierarchical structure. We set aside outdated and restrictive bureau-heavy work flows, allowing creativity and experimentation drive our development process. We leave the stale thinking and predictable approaches to the other people, putting us – and your business solution – one step ahead. Always.
about.excellenceText: Our team employs an agile methodology that allows us to react instantly to the slightest change when necessary. We are capable of reshaping any strategy to satisfy evolving project conditions. This capacity for agile development goes hand in hand with frequent and high-quality communication between our team of professionals and the customer. Clear visuals and timely internal reporting assure that our clients are informed on what work has been completed and what is ongoing.
about.managedByWaiText: WAI Soft have many platforms serving Arab users all over the world. We operate some of the largest Arabic news platforms & women-oriented Facebook pages in the MENA region, among others.
